display_name: Zero-knob Asia box (01-07) sweep-reclaim fade in hunt 08-13, exact-extreme SL + midline TP, intraday flat (v2; entry_gap_policy: skip open-beyond-SL/TP and degenerate box)
hypothesis: On XAUUSD H1 as stamped by the Vantage terminal clock in xauusd_data.csv (NY-close-aligned server_clock_as_stored; no DST conversion), the completed same-day high-low range of server hours 01:00-07:59 is an Asia liquidity box. During hunt hours 08:00-13:59 only, a same-bar pierce of a box extreme that closes back inside (long: low<box_low and close>box_low; short: high>box_high and close<box_high), filled at the next H1 open when still hour<=13, with SL at the exact swept extreme, TP at box midline, one entry per day, and force-flat at the close of hour 13, has no free parameters. Hours are eligibility scaffolding only: no sweep-reclaim event means no trade (flat-while-unswept). Any edge must come from fading stop-runs of the Asia box under Standard STP spread costs. Thin develop n < soft n_trades_min is SCREEN_FAIL, not a waiver.

clock_contract.source: MqlRates time via Mt5ArchBridge TimeToString; fetch_data tags as UTC without conversion
clock_contract.server_topology_note: Develop package shows rollover gap at hour 00 (no bars), London ramp ~10:00, US data/equities ~15:30-16:30 — used only as clock instrumentation for box/hunt edges, not as evidence of edge

rule.box_definition: box_high=max(high), box_low=min(low) over same-calendar-day bars with hour in box_hours_server; undefined until those hours that exist for the day have printed; no trade if box undefined
rule.box_starts_at_01_reason: hour 00 has zero bars (rollover gap); box cannot start at midnight
rule.signal_long: hour[i] in hunt_hours_server and box defined and low[i] < box_low and close[i] > box_low
rule.signal_short: hour[i] in hunt_hours_server and box defined and high[i] > box_high and close[i] < box_high
rule.signal_bar: closed H1 only; pierce and close-back-inside on the SAME bar
rule.entry: if flat and first qualifying signal of the day: fill at open[i+1] only if same calendar day and hour[i+1] <= flat_hour_server; else skip
rule.sl: exact swept extreme — long SL=box_low; short SL=box_high; no buffer
rule.exit: SL or TP or force flat at close of bar with hour >= flat_hour_server same day; no overnight
rule.thin_n_policy: if develop-eligible trade count < gates.soft.n_trades_min then SCREEN_FAIL; not a waiver; do not lower n_trades_min
rule.overlap_note_early_server_range_break_fl: Shares early-block geometry neighborhood with early_server_range_break_flat but differs in pool (01-07 high AND low vs 1-8 high-only), trigger (pierce+close-inside fade vs close-above-high breakout), direction (both sides vs long-only), hunt/flat windows (8-13/13 vs 9-15/16), and risk (exact extreme+midline vs ATR). Not a rename.

entry_gap_policy.rationale: Entry fills at open[i+1] while SL/TP are structural box prices. (a) open beyond own SL ⇒ stop_dist<=0 (ZeroDivisionRisk / nonsense sizing) — skip. (b) open beyond TP ⇒ TP unreachable; trade would degrade to time-flat scratch — skip. (c) box_high==box_low ⇒ SL=TP=extreme, zero-distance — skip. Declared before implementation so n/pnl cannot be chosen post-screen.

predicates.long_open_beyond_sl: direction==long and open[i+1] < box_low (or open[i+1] <= box_low with stop_dist<=0)
predicates.strictness_open_beyond_sl: skip when abs(open[i+1]-sl) produces stop_dist <= 0 under the sizing contract (includes exact equality)

null.algorithm: For each calendar day with m bars: (1) ref_0 = open[0], ref_j = close[j-1] for j>0; (2) inc_j = (open,high,low,close)/ref_j componentwise; (3) circularly rotate the m increments by k in {0..m-1}; (4) rebuild continuous OHLC path from the original day open by chaining rotated increments so each bar unit's open/ref and true-range/ref ratios are preserved as a multiset. Timestamps and spreads remain fixed.
null.notes: Canonical session null for protocol 2.2. base_seed=20260819 is the freeze-date convention (no seed shopping). Required because box extremes, pierce, and reclaim use within-day path geometry.

execution_contract.bar: closed H1 for signal; entry at next bar open

box.high: max(high) over box hours same calendar day
box.low: min(low) over box hours same calendar day

entry.signal: evaluated at bar close of index i in hunt hours
entry.fill: open[i+1] when same calendar day and hour[i+1] <= 13
entry.costs_on_entry_bar: round-trip trade_cost is COMPUTED from entry bar at fill, STORED on the open trade, and DEDUCTED once when exit PnL is booked

costs.measured_at: entry bar (spread_pts, lots sized at entry)

exit.first_eligible_bar: entry bar i+1 (open fill; SL/TP may trigger on entry bar)
exit.sl_fill: exit at sl price when low<=sl (long) or high>=sl (short)
exit.tp_fill: exit at tp when high>=tp (long) or low<=tp (short), only if stop not hit first
exit.time_flat_fill: exit at close[j] when hour[j] >= flat_hour_server
exit.end_of_series: if still in position on last bar of entry day, force close at last close with trade_cost already charged; never carry overnight

sizing.raw_lots: risk_cash / (stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE) with risk_cash = balance * risk_pct; stop_dist = abs(entry - sl)
sizing.skip_if: lots < min_lot OR stop_dist * CONTRACT_SIZE * min_lot > risk_cash
sizing.balance_source: realized balance (starts at start_balance=10000; compounds on booked pnls)

no_overnight.entry_gate: fill only if hour[i+1] <= flat_hour_server same day
no_overnight.day_boundary: if position still open when calendar day changes, fail-closed: do not apply next-day SL/TP

execution_contract.warmup_bars: max(20, box span); no entries before warmup

capital.balance_update: balance += pnl only when a trade is booked at exit
capital.equity_while_open: eq = balance + (close - entry) * CONTRACT_SIZE * lots * direction (floating MTM; trade_cost NOT subtracted until exit)
capital.pnl_on_exit: pnl = (exit_px - entry) * CONTRACT_SIZE * lots * direction - trade_cost; direction = +1 long / -1 short
capital.max_drawdown_pct: peak = running maximum of equity series; dd = (peak - eq) / peak; max_drawdown_pct = max(dd) * 100

supersedes.reason: v1 left gap-at-fill pathologies undeclared for next-open entry vs structural SL/TP: open beyond own SL (stop_dist<=0 / ZeroDivisionRisk), open beyond TP (unreachable target → time-flat scratch), and degenerate box_high==box_low. v2 adds rule.entry_gap_policy (skip all three) + fixtures before any implementation.
